Page 14 Cont.
Dec. 26 Thanksgiv .... Francis Bodey having had trouble with sist-like tumor in side of neck for 8 or 9 yrs. Enrolled last Thursday - Dec. 21st - in Ser. Masses, quite anxious at the time; comes To-day gratified that it broke next day and gave him great relief. Enrolls PP. Souls in Thanksgiving 5.00.
Mrs. Sarah Fitzgerald - in Appleton Wis. - gangrenous foot. Dr's want to amputate leg - daughter phones ....
Pvt. E'd Stevens "missing in action" over Germany ..
Page 15 1945
1945, January
Jan. 2 Mrs. Catherine Lange1 - 69 - diabetis - lost one leg three years ago - Now the other is threatened .... Enrolled by phone To-night.
Dorothy Nett - 27 - fell 3000 feet in an air-plane 31st of last July - 4 vertebrae broken, both ankles and both knees broken also nose. Chin cut and collar-bone. Has not been practical in religion.
Margaret Grix -
Vivian Watson - 32 - heart-trouble-has little child of six and hus- band ....
Fred Leis - 55 - in Luna, 0. - Gangreenous foot - Dr's want to take leg off .... in account of condition.
5 Mrs. Marjorie Warren - 35 - and Family - Husband - Episcopelian - careless in regard to family for some time. - asks for divorce from lutherine wife. She enrolls the Family To-nite. 18th - No improvement so far in outlook; Mrs. advised to turn to Mary our Bl. Mother.
Page 16
Jan. 7 Wm. Gillissie - 29 - shot down -Los Negros - when bombing the Japs. Plane was lost and two of the ten men; two more are still missing. But the other six after 33 days on a raft were saved - Parents re- ceived Telegram Nov. 18 that he was missing since Nov. Ist .- was Enrolled in Ser. Masses Nov. 25th (or) ... Thank ... Enrolled again 5.
7 Robert Hamilton - 44 - Enrolled last Wednesday expecting brain, tumor operation on Friday. Dr's who had X-rayed his head were astounded at finding no tumor atal. However, they now predict blindness to follow! Brain Dr. - Crawford in Ford Hospital - Eye Dr. - Dr. Whit- ney ... Patient still in Ford's.
